purpose: low-context cost-aware routing for agents, parallel work and local models

cost_classes.local: no per-call hosted API fee; local compute and licensing still matter
cost_classes.included: uses a plan or credit bucket; verify current allowance
cost_classes.unknown: do not assume cost until verified

event_driven_ci_continuation.rule: prefer completion events over timers/polling; continuation is a new agent run, so persist state durably

delegation_trigger.must_consider_when: task has at least 3 independent bounded workstreams and at least 2 can execute without shared mutable state
delegation_trigger.decision_rule: compare deterministic, local, included and paid routes; delegate only when expected wall-clock/context benefit exceeds coordination overhead

required_for: delegation used or deliberately skipped after trigger
trace_rule.sink: project audit/final report; do not create a permanent trace file unless the project already has an audit/log surface
